title: Moreton House, Bideford
scope: The standing Georgian Moreton House on Abbotsham Road, including the principal hipped-roof block, service courts and directly connected ranges.
limitations: Exterior of the individually listed house and attached ranges. The separately listed former stables, gardens and interiors are outside scope.
The mapped outline and front and rear Qualla photos control the exterior; exact roof heights, concealed elements and small details are estimated.
